File: 11250-30/5748.01


Date: July 5, 2021


RE: Notice of Closure for Harrison East FSR (5748.01) - Rescinded



Under the authority of Section 6(1) of the Forest Service Road Use Regulation, I am
rescinding the notice of closure dated June 25, 2021 to public and industrial traffic
access for the purposed of road user safety.

Please be aware of “Rockfall hazard – NO stopping” signs located at 13.0 km.



Yours truly,
  Digitally signed by
  Mike Peters
  Date: 2021.07.05
  11:03:02 -07'00'
Mike Peters
District Manager
Chilliwack Natural Resource District
